channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran disregards Trump's warning, asserts new strikes on U.S.-used bases
item.description: Iran reports fresh attacks on American forces in Kuwait and the UAE, while the Pentagon investigates claims of a U.S. strike hitting a wedding...

item.title: Gloria Steinem, pioneering women's rights advocate, passes away at 92
item.description: As co-founder of Ms. Magazine, she championed gender equality and fought against violence toward women while advocating for broader inclusion and representation.

item.title: Republican senator publicly criticizes Hegseth as 'inept'
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth faces growing bipartisan criticism over his handling of the Iran war, with more Republicans joining Democrats in voicing concerns.

item.title: US journalist receives two-year federal prison sentence
item.description: An American journalist was sentenced to two years in federal prison for acting as an agent of a foreign government within the United States.
